LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsFlightAssistTip: While piloting, axes without player input are counter-thrusted using the ship's real thruster power (no artificial damping).
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsHostMapSizeNote: Display/performance parameter for the space host map. Applied the next time the test scene is created; does not affect universe coordinates.
LanguageData.DeltaV_SettingsLogNote: Module-gated verbose logs ([DeltaV:Module] prefix). Warnings/errors and key state transitions (pilot enter/exit, suppression activation, patch init) are always logged regardless.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockSuccess: {0} secured in fixed orbit on the space anchor map.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockFailOutOfRange: Ship's universe position is not within the host map area. Fly closer to the anchor first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockFailBlocked: Landing area on the host map is blocked. Pick another spot or clear it first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockFailNoEngine: No grav engine found on the ship. Fixed orbit requires a grav engine as the ship's structural anchor.
LanguageData.DeltaV_DockFailBusy: Another gravship landing or flight operation is already in progress.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ConsoleGizmoPrimaryTip: The ship's heading when returning to flight follows the primary console's facing.
LanguageData.DeltaV_ConsolePrimary: This is the primary pilot console.
